create_quoref_dataset: create a Quoref dataset instance to load and preprocess the Quoref QA dataset from Hugging Face
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face Quoref dataset split to a list of question-context input and answer output tuples
load_quoref_dataset: load the Quoref dataset from Hugging Face using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data splits for the Quoref dataset with configurable seed and k value
run_quoref_preprocessing: run the Quoref preprocessing pipeline to generate train dev and test splits for multiple random seeds
